==Description==
The '''SCT''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that could only be found in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|legacy Hidden Wave]], which meant it could only be found in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode.

The '''SCT''' was fast and had high health. However, in comparison to other [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] enemies, its health was relatively low. It could also shoot towers, stunning them for a short period of time.

==Appearance==
The '''SCT''' was also known as the ''Fallen Scout''. This was because the '''SCT''' uses the same model as the Level 3 of the original default [[Scout]]. It wore a black tactical vest, knee-pads, shades and gloves. It had reflective black skin, and its torso and legs were granite green. It carried a blue HK P2000 pistol in its right hand to shoot at towers.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Turret]] are recommended to kill this [[Enemies|enemy]].
**The [[Commander]] is essential in order to boost the firerate of towers to kill this enemy quickly.
*The [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]], [[Sledger]] and [[Toxic Gunner]] help greatly in slowing this enemy down.
*When attacking a tower, the '''SCT''' becomes immobile.
**For this reason, it is recommended to distract this enemy for other towers to attack it.

==Trivia==
*The '''SCT's''' appearance was very similar to the first version of the Level 3 Default [[Scout]].
**Its name was shorthand for <u>SC</u>ou<u>T</u>.
***Hence, many people called the '''SCT''' the ''Fallen Scout''.
***Ironically, a {{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} skin would eventually be added for the [[Scout]] during the [[V1.27.0|Fallen Foes Update]].
*The '''SCT's''' health was likely a reference to the number 666, a number associated with the Devil.
